decisions.reason: §1 explains the session/tool worker IS the host process, npm removes the tree out from under the live host, and no result recorder survives; grounded in the fixture's host path, 'npm info remove', and '<no result recorded>' log lines.

§2 identifies the two-phase install, death at linkStuff before shim generation: content present but dsh/dsh.cmd MISSING and dsh.ps1 stale, and explains hand-swapping creates a non-standard install that makes things worse, citing env-state.txt and repair-notes.md.

§3 describes the external, pinned re-run of 'npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1' from outside the host, shim regeneration, dsh --version → 0.1.2-rc.1 verification, and rejection of hand-patching.

§4 states the agent should recognize the self-host situation, refuse to execute (never-run-from-inside as a hard rule), fully stop all dsh processes before npm, and hand the user the ordered pinned external procedure; no best-effort in-place attempt is endorsed.

§5 gives a pre-execution self-upgrade intent guard (identity/pattern check, refuse with external hand-off, equivalents covered) plus a checklist with version-marker verification, plugin load verification, backup/rollback cleanup, and treats the zero-diff (252 files, version bumps only, cardCount 0) outcome as no-re-migration/already-current.
